expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white/very light on a pale mint-green background, making it nearly unreadable and failing contrast requirements.
The third restaurant card title in 'Fastest near you' shows 'Trattoria Piccol' — the name is cut off at the screen edge without an ellipsis, appearing broken rather than intentionally truncated.
A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge showing only a thin sliver, which looks like a rendering glitch rather than an obvious scrollable carousel.
The 'Order now' button on the promo banner is white-on-light-green with light green text, giving it weak visual affordance against the already pale banner.
